text:
𝗡𝗜𝗖𝗛𝗢𝗟𝗟𝗦 𝟭𝟳𝟱* 𝗔𝗚𝗔𝗜𝗡𝗦𝗧 𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔! 🔥

NZ were 70/5, then Nicholls (335 balls) and Phillips added 216.
NZ all out 368; Bumrah took 4/92. India 18/0.

How big is this lead? 👇

#INDvNZ #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗡𝗜𝗖𝗛𝗢𝗟𝗟𝗦 𝗞𝗔 𝗡𝗔𝗡𝗗 𝟭𝟳𝟱*! 🔥🏏

👉 NZ 70/5 pe the, phir Nicholls aur Phillips ne 216 run jode
👉 Nicholls 175* (335 gend, 21 chauke)
👉 NZ 368 all out, Bumrah ke 4/92
👉 India 18/0 – ab batting ki baari

India ko kitna peeche rakha NZ ne? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #INDvNZ #TeamIndia
